latestVersion.changelog:
4K With Session 1.0.0

- Launches seamless 4K video editing: upload footage, edit, and export without complex controls.
- Introduces session saving, allowing you to return and resume editing without re-uploading videos.
- Supports major video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and audio/image formats; max file size 500MB.
- Automated setup: anonymous session and credits handled for fast start.
- Real-time cloud rendering delivers prompt 4K exports (MP4, H.264).
- Intuitive command routing and status updates ensure clarity throughout editing and export workflows.
